attempts.summary: Enabled and persisted a ufw-based host firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 24.04): default policy rejects incoming, allows outgoing; explicit allow rules for tcp/22 (SSH) and tcp/8080; ufw service enabled at boot. Verified enforcement at the kernel nftables level and via live connection tests (8080 reachable with a bound listener, an unrelated port refused). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a background systemctl reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed a changed boot_id (fresh uptime), and re-verified ufw active/enabled with identical rules and nftables policy post-restart.
